title: HSK 2.4 · 生活, 办法, 方面, 心情, 运动
focus: 生活 · 公司 · 名 · 而且 · 必须 · 长 · 其他 · 事情 · 条 · 其中 · 办法 · 离开 · 生 · 方法 · 方面 · 面 · 活动 · 中心 · 开心 · 办 · 故事 · 可爱 · 离 · 面前 · 条件 · 运动 · 样子 · 办公室 · 爱情 · 方向 · 关心 · 日子 · 心里 · 心情 · 怎么样 · 小心 · 怎么办 · 想法 · 动物
body:
Everyday-life words built from a few busy characters: 心 heart (six words), 办 handle, 方 direction/side, 法 method and 动 move. Once you know these, words like 办法, 方法 and 想法 read themselves.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 心 | xīn | heart, mind | 中心, 开心, 关心, 心里, 心情, 小心 |
| 办 | bàn | to handle, do | 办, 办法, 办公室, 怎么办 |
| 方 | fāng | direction, side, way | 方法, 方面, 方向 |
| 法 | fǎ | method, law (氵 water + 去 go) | 办法, 方法, 想法 |
| 面 | miàn | face, side | 面, 方面, 面前 |
| 动 | dòng | to move (力 strength on the right) | 活动, 运动, 动物 |
| 生 | shēng | to be born, life | 生, 生活 |
| 情 | qíng | feeling (忄 heart + 青 qīng) | 事情, 爱情, 心情 |

## Watch out

- 长 has two readings: cháng long (很长) and zhǎng grow / head (长大, 校长).
- 办 bàn and 为 wèi look alike: 办 is 力 with a dot on each side.
- 面 miàn also means noodles (面条), because simplification merged it with 麵.

cards.Example: 我很喜欢这里的生活。 wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ de shēnghuó: I really like life here
cards.Notes: 生 born, life + 活 alive (氵 water + 舌) = living one's life

cards.Example: 他在一家公司工作。 tā zài yì jiā gōngsī gōngzuò: He works at a company
cards.Notes: 公 public + 司 to manage = a business that is run; 司 also in 司机 driver

cards.Example: 你叫什么名字？ nǐ jiào shénme míngzi: What's your name?
cards.Notes: 夕 evening + 口 mouth; traditional explanation: in the dark you call out your name. Also in 名字, 有名

cards.Example: 她很聪明，而且很努力。 tā hěn cōngming, érqiě hěn nǔlì: She's smart, and hardworking too
cards.Notes: 而 and/but + 且 moreover; often after 不但: 不但…而且… not only… but also

cards.Example: 你必须早点睡。 nǐ bìxū zǎo diǎn shuì: You must sleep earlier
cards.Notes: 必 certainly + 须 need = must. 须 = 彡 hair + 页 head (originally 'beard')

cards.Example: 这条路很长。 zhè tiáo lù hěn cháng: This road is long
cards.Notes: Simplified from 長, a figure with long hair. cháng long (长短); zhǎng grow, chief (长大, 校长)

cards.Example: 其他人都走了。 qítā rén dōu zǒu le: Everyone else has left
cards.Notes: 其 that/those + 他 (originally 'other') = the others

cards.Example: 这个事情我知道。 zhège shìqing wǒ zhīdào: I know about this.
cards.Notes: 情 = 忄 heart + 青; 情 and 晴 differ only in the radical

cards.Example: 我买了一条鱼。 wǒ mǎi le yì tiáo yú: I bought a fish
cards.Notes: 木 tree/wood at the bottom: a twig, so long thin things: 一条路, 一条河, 一条裤子

cards.Example: 三个人，其中两个是学生。 sān ge rén, qízhōng liǎng ge shì xuésheng: Three people, two of them students
cards.Notes: 其 those + 中 middle = in the middle of those, among them

cards.Example: 我有一个好办法。 wǒ yǒu yí ge hǎo bànfǎ: I have a good idea
cards.Notes: 办 handle + 法 method = a way of handling it; 没办法 = nothing can be done

cards.Example: 他明天离开北京。 tā míngtiān líkāi Běijīng: He leaves Beijing tomorrow
cards.Notes: 离 apart from + 开 open, away = to go away from

cards.Meaning: to be born; to give birth; raw; student
cards.Example: 她生了一个女儿。 tā shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér: She gave birth to a daughter
cards.Notes: Picture of a sprout coming up from the ground: life, birth. In 学生, 医生, 生日, 先生

cards.Example: 这个方法很好。 zhège fāngfǎ hěn hǎo: This method works well
cards.Notes: 方 way, direction + 法 method = method; compare 办法 (a way out of a problem)

cards.Example: 这方面我不太懂。 zhè fāngmiàn wǒ bú tài dǒng: I don't know much about this area
cards.Notes: 方 side + 面 face = one face of a thing, an aspect

cards.Example: 我想吃面。 wǒ xiǎng chī miàn: I want to eat noodles
cards.Notes: Pictures a face. Also the simplified form of 麵 noodles, so 面条 noodles; and side in 外面, 后面

cards.Example: 周末有什么活动？ zhōumò yǒu shénme huódòng: What's on this weekend?
cards.Notes: 活 alive + 动 move = being active; an activity or event

cards.Example: 我住在城市中心。 wǒ zhù zài chéngshì zhōngxīn: I live downtown
cards.Notes: 中 middle + 心 heart = the heart of something, the center

cards.Example: 今天我很开心。 jīntiān wǒ hěn kāixīn: I'm really happy today
cards.Notes: 开 open + 心 heart = an opened-up heart, happy

cards.Example: 这件事我来办。 zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái bàn: I'll take care of this
cards.Notes: 力 strength with a dot on each side; simplified from 辦 (辛 辛 around 力). Lookalike: 为 wèi

cards.Example: 妈妈给我讲故事。 māma gěi wǒ jiǎng gùshi: Mom tells me stories
cards.Notes: 故 old, past + 事 matter = things from the past, a story. 故 = 古 gǔ old (also sound) + 攵

cards.Example: 这只小狗真可爱！ zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu zhēn kě'ài: This puppy is so cute!
cards.Notes: 可 can, worth + 爱 love = worth loving, cute

cards.Meaning: away from, distance from; to leave
cards.Example: 我家离学校很近。 wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn: My home is close to school
cards.Notes: Simplified from 離. Used for distance: A 离 B 很远 = A is far from B

cards.Example: 他站在我面前。 tā zhàn zài wǒ miànqián: He stood in front of me
cards.Notes: 面 face + 前 front = right before one's face

cards.Example: 这里的条件不太好。 zhèlǐ de tiáojiàn bú tài hǎo: Conditions here aren't great
cards.Notes: 条 item (as in a list) + 件 piece = the items required, conditions

cards.Example: 我每天运动一个小时。 wǒ měitiān yùndòng yí ge xiǎoshí: I exercise an hour a day
cards.Notes: 运 transport, move (辶 walk + 云 yún sound) + 动 move = movement, exercise

cards.Example: 他看起来很累的样子。 tā kàn qǐlai hěn lèi de yàngzi: He looks tired
cards.Notes: 样 shape, pattern (木 + 羊 yáng sound) + 子 noun suffix = how something looks

cards.Example: 老师在办公室。 lǎoshī zài bàngōngshì: The teacher is in the office
cards.Notes: 办 handle + 公 public business + 室 room = room for handling work

cards.Example: 这是一个爱情故事。 zhè shì yí ge àiqíng gùshi: This is a love story
cards.Notes: 爱 love + 情 feeling = romantic love (not family love)

cards.Example: 我们走错方向了。 wǒmen zǒu cuò fāngxiàng le: We went the wrong way
cards.Notes: 方 direction + 向 toward = direction

cards.Meaning: to care about, be concerned for
cards.Example: 谢谢你关心我。 xièxie nǐ guānxīn wǒ: Thanks for caring about me
cards.Notes: 关 concern, relate to (also close) + 心 heart = to keep someone in one's heart

cards.Meaning: day; date; life (days of one's life)
cards.Example: 今天是个好日子。 jīntiān shì ge hǎo rìzi: Today is a good day
cards.Notes: 日 sun, day + 子 noun suffix; 过日子 = to live one's life

cards.Meaning: in one's heart, in one's mind
cards.Example: 我心里很高兴。 wǒ xīnli hěn gāoxìng: I'm happy inside
cards.Notes: 心 heart + 里 inside = inside one's heart

cards.Example: 今天我心情不好。 jīntiān wǒ xīnqíng bù hǎo: I'm in a bad mood today
cards.Notes: 心 heart + 情 feeling = mood

cards.Example: 我们去看电影，怎么样？ wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng, zěnmeyàng: How about a movie?
cards.Notes: 怎么 how + 样 appearance = what does it look like, how is it

cards.Example: 路上小心！ lùshang xiǎoxīn: Be careful on the way!
cards.Notes: 小 small + 心 heart = keep your heart small, attentive: be careful

cards.Example: 我的钱丢了，怎么办？ wǒ de qián diū le, zěnmebàn: I lost my money, what do I do?
cards.Notes: 怎么 how + 办 handle = how to handle it

cards.Example: 你的想法很好。 nǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn hǎo: Your idea is great
cards.Notes: 想 think + 法 method = a way of thinking, an idea

cards.Example: 我喜欢小动物。 wǒ xǐhuan xiǎo dòngwù: I like little animals
cards.Notes: 动 move + 物 thing = things that move, animals; 物 = 牛 cow + 勿 (sound)
